name: local-context
description: Local MCP for files, shell, SQLite, and scheduled tasks. Results are size-capped and the server never calls the Claude API.

root_dir.title: Allowed root
root_dir.description: Directory the plugin may read and use as the shell working directory. Leave empty to use the current project.

max_output_chars.title: Max characters per result
max_output_chars.description: Hard cap on every tool result so one call cannot dump a large file into the context window.

allow_shell.title: Allow terminal commands
allow_shell.description: Let Claude run commands inside the allowed root. Anthropic environment variables are removed, and commands that target Claude credential files or the Anthropic API are refused.
